meta.title: Baha Ready 3D
meta.description: A 3D game for learning flood and typhoon preparedness, from Signal No. 1 to Signal No. 5.

landing.headline: Get ready before the water rises.
landing.lede: Pack a go-bag, prepare the house, and evacuate safely as the storm signal climbs. Every level explains what you did right and why.
landing.meterLabel: Levels from Signal No. 1 to Signal No. 5
landing.feature1Title: A go-bag at the right weight
landing.feature1Body: Pick what you really need. Weight and time are limited.
landing.feature2Body: Avoid live wires, open manholes, and strong currents.
landing.feature3Body: Guide elderly people, children, and PWDs to the evacuation center.

offline.body: You can still play levels you've downloaded. Results will save once you're back online.
offline.banner: Offline — progress will save when you're back online.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.challengeLede: Open your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator) and enter the 6-digit code.
mfa.setupLede: Facilitators and admins need this to protect students' and residents' data.
mfa.step1: Install Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or a similar app.
mfa.step2: Scan this QR code with the app.
mfa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app.

onboarding.usernameHint: 3–20 characters: letters, numbers, or _. This is what others see on leaderboards.
onboarding.minorNotice: Since you're under 18, let a parent or guardian know you're using Baha Ready. We won't ask for any more personal information.
